entries.text: ClickHouse and ClickHouse Local runs with a non-default seed no longer fail to export their result: a row count accepted within the loose tolerance is now recorded as skipped with the tolerance warning, as on other platforms, instead of as a pass with unequal counts.

TPC-DS query 75 no longer fails with a division by zero on PostgreSQL-compatible platforms such as CedarDB: the prior-year sales count divisor is guarded with NULLIF on every platform, as query 90 already is, so all platforms return the same rows.
